text:
Ivy (CSM): Elena, quick health ping — onboarding looks good but we noticed p95 spikes on /chat during peak. Renewal in 5 weeks; can we try a low-risk perf experiment?

Elena (BlueHarbor): Were on Dedicated in us-west, compliance needs any binary hashes but otherwise fine. Majority traffic is short confirmations (~55%) and medium summaries. No slot changes pre-renewal.

Mark (Solutions Eng): Low-friction options: 1) route short confirmations to assistant-lite-q4, 2) enable prefix KV for repeated templates, 3) tighten batching for medium summaries. Example rule 
```yaml
routes:
  - match: {intent: "confirm", tokens: "<120"}
    target: redwood/assistant-lite-1.3b-q4
cache: {prefix_kv: true, ttl_seconds: 3600}
```

Samir (Product): Recommend 1% -> 5% canary over 3h, monitors p95, error_rate, and 30-sample quality smoke. Auto-rollback if p95 increases >18% or quality drops >3%. Capture token-savings for renewal.

Elena (BlueHarbor): 1%->5% OK. Compliance will need the checksum (48h). Avoid canary during nightly settlements 01:00 PST.

deploy-bot: Notice: Dedicated maintenance us-west scheduled at 2012350000. Rollouts paused during window.

Ivy (CSM): Action items: Mark to produce vetted q4 artifact + config, Samir to add 30 golden prompts and token probe, Elena to confirm compliance slot. Goal: reduce p95 by ~15-20% and tokens for short confirms by ~12-20% without quality regression.

Mark (Solutions Eng): Playbook notes and rollback: `redwood canary start --route /chat --artifact assistant-lite-q4` and `redwood canary abort --route /chat`.
